text:
elaine (PM): Quick sync — deciding scope for the new "visibility-lite" console work. AcmeHealth and several enterprise prospects want per-route cost attribution + easy export for audits. Tradeoff: full tracing now vs phased approach.

devon (eng): Full per-request span export will increase dataplane load and backend storage. I propose we prioritize cost attribution first, with lightweight sampled traces for the top routes.

raj (eng-sre): Agree. Constraints to keep in mind: keep agent CPU overhead <5% p95 and avoid unbounded trace retention. We should gate by top-N routes and sampling.

maria (design): From a UX POV customers most want to correlate cost spikes with error-rate and latency. We can prototype a "route insights" card that shows route cost (hourly), p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and one sample trace.

sophie (cs): AcmeHealth compliance requires route-level CSV export for audits. They'll accept sampled traces as long as cost attribution is exact.

josh (sales): Multiple prospects flagged audit exports as a gating requirement for Dedicated/Private. This impacts deals.

elaine (PM): Two options: (A) Cost-first v1: ship per-route cost breakdown + CSV export + insights card + 1% sampled traces for top-10 routes. (B) Tracing-first v1: ship comprehensive error sampling/traces, basic cost estimates.

devon (eng): Cost-first is much simpler: cost can be computed from existing token and routing metadata. Tracing-first needs pipeline changes and increases storage.

raj (eng-sre): Also prefer cost-first so we can iterate on aggregation window (hourly vs realtime) before adding heavy trace traffic. Add a mandatory circuit-breaker for exporter backpressure.

maria (design): Cost-first lets us design a focused dashboard without premature complexity. We'll tie sampled traces into the insights card later.

sophie (cs): If cost-first, i'll ask AcmeHealth for a 2-week CSV pilot to validate format.

deploy-bot: canary created: visibility-lite-canary-2026-03-targets: acme, beta-corp, internal-test

elaine (PM): Draft acceptance criteria for cost-first v1 — please react with :thumbsup: or :thinking: if concerns: 

```
Acceptance criteria (cost-first v1):
- Per-route cost breakdown visible in Console (hourly aggregation)
- Route insights card: cost, p50/p95 latency, error-rate, top sampled trace (1%)
- CSV export of per-route cost & tags
- Canary rollout to 3 pilot orgs with smoke tests green for 48h
- Dataplane CPU overhead <5% during pilot
- Exporter backpressure circuit-breaker implemented
- Documentation and quickstart available
```

devon (eng): :thumbsup: realistic in 6 sprints if limited to hourly agg and top-10 routes for the insights card.

raj (eng-sre): :thinking: require explicit SLOs for trace retention and fail-open behavior for exporter outages. Add gating item: circuit-breaker + fail-open default.

maria (design): :thumbsup: will deliver mockups for desktop and narrow screens by Thu EOD.

sophie (cs): i'll confirm pilot window and CSV spec with AcmeHealth.

josh (sales): i'll attach pilot agreement to the ticket.

elaine (PM): Actions:
- devon: tech spec for cost aggregation and tagging by Tue
- raj: circuit-breaker design and canary runbook by Wed
- maria: mockups by Thu
- sophie/josh: pilot confirmation by Fri

elaine (PM): If no objections by EOD today I'll lock scope and open PRD.

devon (eng): no objections from eng.

raj (eng-sre): no objections if circuit-breaker is mandatory.

maria (design): no objections.

sophie (cs): ok.

josh (sales): ok.

elaine (PM): Locking scope and creating PRD now. Will paste link when ready. :raised_hands:
